title: Immich: first weekend
summary: Docker Compose on the lab box, open the web UI, point the phone at LAN. Mark installed when uploads work.

start.body: Immich is a photo library you run. This weekend: get Compose up and one phone uploading. Not a full migration yet.

prereq.body:
You need at least 6 GB of RAM (8 GB is comfortable), 2 CPU cores, Docker with Compose, room on a disk for the photos plus 10–20% for thumbnails, and the box reachable on house Wi-Fi. Check from SSH:

```
free -h
df -h
```

No public exposure this weekend.

need-docker.body:
Download Docker's script, read it, then run it:

```
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o ~/get-docker.sh
less ~/get-docker.sh
sudo sh ~/get-docker.sh
```

Check that both parts answer with a version number:

```
sudo docker version
sudo docker compose version
```

It is docker compose with a space; the old docker-compose with a dash is not supported.

compose.body:
Get Immich's two files for the current release and open the settings:

```
mkdir ~/immich-app && cd ~/immich-app
wget -O docker-compose.yml https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases/latest/download/docker-compose.yml
wget -O .env https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases/latest/download/example.env
nano .env
```

Set UPLOAD_LOCATION to a path on the big disk, like /srv/photos/immich. Set DB_PASSWORD to a long mix of letters and numbers. Uncomment TZ and set your time zone. Then start it and wait until the containers say healthy:

```
sudo docker compose up -d
sudo docker compose ps
```

web.body: From a laptop on house Wi-Fi, open http://192.168.1.50:2283 with your own address. The first account you create is the admin: use a real password and write it down somewhere that is not the old PC. Don't forward port 2283 on the router.

phone.body: Install the Immich app. For the server URL, type the same http://address:2283 and log in. Open the backup screen (the cloud icon), pick the camera album and turn backup on. Take one test photo and watch it show up on the web page. Don't delete anything from the phone yet.

stuck.body:
Check that every container is up, and read the server log if one keeps restarting:

```
sudo docker compose ps
sudo docker compose logs immich-server --tail 50
```

Also check disk space and that the phone is on the same house Wi-Fi. Come back for Immich: make it better when uploads click.

done.body: Good. Photos are landing. The next guided project is Immich: make it better — storage, users, and not blowing the disk.
